metadata.name: GetTransactionDetailsLoyalty
metadata.description: This API is used to get loyalty transaction details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Example:8000000000000037 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number  (Embossing Account id) Valid Values:0-9 Example:82432455 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution. Valid Values:0-9 Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: DetailActivityType
request_fields.description: Activity Type can be specified for specific transactions . Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.55 (Activity Type) Example : 12 = Earned Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values- 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:11642

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: StatementFrom
request_fields.description: Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: StatementTo
request_fields.description: Used as a criteria for Transaction Filter. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch. Default Value would be 100 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: XX Example: 12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DetailsCount
children.description: Number of Transactions. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xx Example: 20

children.name: TransactionList
children.description: List of Transactions.

children.name: ReversalTarget
children.description: ID for the reversed loyalty points. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxx Example: 123abc

children.name: PromoPoints
children.description: Accumulated Promotional Point. Valid Values:0-9 Example : 12.00

children.name: LoyaltyExpirationDate
children.description: Loyalty Points Expiration Date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: TransactionPostTime
children.description: Time of Transaction  posted. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: DetailActivityType
children.description: Activity Type can be specified for specific transactions. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.55 (Activity Type) Example : 12 = Earned Allowable Values: 2

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: LoyaltyPoints
children.description: Total accumulated loyalty points of the Account. Example: 810.00

children.name: EquivalentAmount
children.description: Equivalent amount based on points. Example : 250.00

children.name: EquivalentAmount_Web
children.description: Equivalent amount based on points. Example : 250.00

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Name of the Merchant. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: StoreName
children.description: Name of the Store Valid Values:Wallmart Format:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Wallmart Condition:Core Card will provide the value for this field after the Program is setup. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RegisterName
children.description: Register Name in a merchant hierarchy Valid Values:a-z, 0-9 Format: xxxx Example:abc 123 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Example:8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: TransactionReference
children.description: Reference number of Transaction. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Format: Example:321dss2 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: MerchantNameandLocation
children.description: Name and location details of merchant Valid Values: a-z A-Z Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Dental merchant, Nashua Allowable Values: 40

children.name: CardNumberLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: TransactionSource
children.description: Transaction source like ACH, manual etc. Example:5=IPM, For  Retail =29(Installment Purchase) Retail =39(Credit Purchase)  Retail=23 (Manual Auth) Allowable Values: 2

children.name: TransactionSourceDescription
children.description: Description of Transaction Source. Example : Manual Auth Allowable Values: 100

children.name: PostDateTime
children.description: This is the time when transaction actually got posted in system. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: MerchantCategory
children.description: Identifier for the Merchant Category. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example:1d3f4 Allowable Values: 200

children.name: MCCDescription
children.description: Description of the Merchant Category Code. Valid Values: 0-9, a-z Format:xxxx Example: 123abc Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MCCCode
children.description: Unique code assigned for Merchant Category. Valid Values: 0-9, a-z Format:xxxx Example: 123abc Allowable Values: 100

children.name: RedemptionType
children.description: ACH or Statement Credit for Redeemption transaction. Example:3 (Statement Credit) Allowable Values: 20

children.name: PromoTxnAmount
children.description: Amount qualified for Promotional points. Example:150.00

children.name: LoyaltyProgramID
children.description: ID of Loyalty Program.

children.name: LoyaltyProgramName
children.description: Name of Loyalty Program. Example: Card Loyalty Program Allowable Values: 50

children.name: BasePercent
children.description: Base Percent of an Loyalty transaction. Example:1.20

children.name: PromoPercent
children.description: Promotional Percent of a loyalty program. Example:2.00

children.name: TotalPercent
children.description: Total Percentage (Base percent + promo percent) Example:3.20

children.name: RewardRedeemStatus
children.description: The status of reward redemption. Valid Values: a-z 0-9 Format: xxx Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ClientUniqueId
children.description: Unique Identifier for the client. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: 123abc

children.name: PartnerID
children.description: Unique ID of Partner Valid Values: 0-9, A-B Format:XXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 256

children.name: ReasonCode
children.description: Reason Code field for Error or Success of API. Example:0 Allowable Values: 30

children.name: RedeemBankAccountName
children.description: Name of bank or loan servicer account where loyalty points are redeemed. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789

children.name: RuleName
children.description: Name of the Loyalty Rule. Example:Base Rule Allowable Values: 20

children.name: DebitCreditIndicator
children.description: It tells if the loyalty transaction is debit or credit. Valid Values: 1 = Debit , -1 =  Credit Example:1

children.name: LoyaltyPointsMgmtResponseID
children.description: A unique identifier generated from the LoyaltyPointsManagement transaction. It can be used to track and link the transaction across systems. Example: 7485122 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Valid Values:0-9, a-z Format:xxx Example:200 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AccountUUID
children.description: Unique additional Identification Number generated by system for an Account. Valid Values: Format: Example:a585f533-0d33-4282-ab98-4852146e5e17 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AdminNumberUUID
children.description: Unique additional Identification Number generated by system for an Admin Number. Valid Values: Format: Example:a585f533-0d33-4282-ab98-4852146e5e17 Allowable Values: 20
